setup.title: Tell us about your organization
setup.subtitle: C2B uses these details to recommend the right programmes for your teams. You can edit them later.
setup.submitted: Organization submitted. C2B will review it shortly.

status.pendingText: Thanks for registering! A C2B admin is reviewing your organization. Once approved, you can invite your employees.
status.pendingShort: Invite links become available once C2B approves your organization.
status.rejectedText: C2B could not approve your organization yet. Update your details and save to resubmit.
status.suspendedText: Invite links are disabled. Employees can still log in and view their data. Contact C2B for details.

dashboard.inviteText: Share this link so employees can join and build their profiles.

settings.title: Organization details
settings.subtitle: Keep your details up to date. They guide the AI recommendations for your teams.
settings.logoHint: Square images look best. JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB.

form.name: Organization name
form.departmentsHint: Employees choose from this list. Invite links can target one department.
form.trainingHint: The AI uses these to align employee pathways with your strategy.
form.goalsHint: e.g. Launch digital banking, Move to the cloud

invites.title: Invite links
invites.subtitle: Employees join your organization only through these links. Create one per team, set an expiry or a seat limit.
invites.label: Label
invites.departmentHint: Pre-fills the department for people who join with this link.
invites.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the link and copy it manually.
invites.regenerated: New link generated. The old link no longer works.
invites.regenerateText: A new URL will be created and the old one will stop working immediately. People who already joined aren't affected.
invites.deleteText: The link will stop working. People who already joined aren't affected.
invites.emptyText: Create a link and share it with your employees.
invites.notApprovedText: You can create and share invite links once C2B approves your organization.

errors.pastDate: Choose a date in the future.

employees.title: Employees
employees.subtitle: Review profiles, add remarks and submit complete profiles to C2B for AI-powered pathways.
employees.selectAll: Select all employees ready to submit
employees.bulkFailedTitle: Some profiles could not be submitted
employees.emptyText: Share an invite link so your employees can join.
employees.submitText: {{name}}'s profile will be locked while C2B prepares their pathway. You can still add remarks.
employees.alreadySubmitted: This profile has been submitted to C2B.
employees.notReady: The employee needs to complete at least 80% of their profile before you can submit it.
employees.deactivateText: {{name}} will no longer be able to log in.
employees.inactiveNotice: This employee has been deactivated and cannot log in.
employees.noPathway: No pathway has been published for this employee yet.
employees.noEnrollments: This employee has no enrollments yet.
employees.deleteText: {{name}}'s account, profile, pathways and enrollments will be permanently deleted. To only remove their access, deactivate them instead.

remarks.title: Remarks
remarks.subtitle: Visible to the employee (read-only) and to C2B. Used by the AI when recommending programmes.
remarks.placeholder: e.g. Strong potential for cloud architecture; priority skill for 2027.
remarks.deleteText: The employee and C2B will no longer see it.
